title: OpenDocuments product assistant trial: document Q&A MVP
taskScope: Use OpenDocuments as a public reference to design a two-week document Q&A MVP trial for an enterprise knowledge-base scenario. The output is a controlled trial artifact, not a claim of repository contribution or production delivery.

fixedQuestions.title: Reference project understanding
fixedQuestions.prompt: Describe what OpenDocuments appears to solve as a public reference project, including its inputs, outputs, citation or source-display behavior, and visible boundaries.

fixedQuestions.title: Product-role connection
fixedQuestions.prompt: Explain which product-assistant tasks this reference can help you practice, such as requirement breakdown, user stories, QA-pair design, MVP scope, and acceptance criteria.

fixedQuestions.title: Scenario gap
fixedQuestions.prompt: For your chosen domain context, list the missing business materials, source policies, user groups, and review steps that would be needed before a real product trial.

fixedQuestions.title: Two-week MVP plan
fixedQuestions.prompt: Draft a two-week MVP plan covering target users, document scope, core Q&A flows, failure handling, metrics, and review boundaries.

fixedQuestions.title: Portfolio boundary
fixedQuestions.prompt: Write a portfolio-safe summary that separates public reference capabilities from your own trial output and makes source, license, and attribution boundaries visible.

fixedQuestions.title: AI usage explanation
fixedQuestions.prompt: If you used AI assistance, explain which parts it helped draft or structure and which parts you checked, revised, or rejected.
